data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Contradiction. The preference for better-corroborated theories (SRC_004) contradicts the claim that such preference inevitably smuggles induction back into Popper's system (SRC_005). REFUTED IF: It can be demonstrated that 'conjectural risk management' (SRC_004) logically entails an assumption of the uniformity of nature, thereby validating the 'Hidden Inductive Leap' mechanism described in SRC_005 rather than circumventing it.
